title: DonatJS Core: A Zero-Dependency JSON-Driven Client-Side Router and UI Rendering Engine
description:
DonatJS Core (script.js) is a zero-dependency, no-build-step client-side rendering (CSR) engine that transforms structured data (JSON) into dynamic web interfaces through a polymorphic component dispatch system. Developed at Sismadi Lab (sismadi.com) — Experimental Zone, where Frameworks Are Born Before Becoming Products — owned by PT Sismadi Langit Solusi. Sismadi Lab is an open experimentation space where every framework and tool is tested before being promoted to teaching materials or packaged as a product.

DonatJS is the third generation in the framework lineage born at the same lab: Ktupad (2019, EC00201952487) → BayamJS (2023, EC00202367008) → DonatJS (2024, EC00202414144), all registered as official copyrights at DJKI (Direktorat Jenderal Kekayaan Intelektual), Republic of Indonesia.

DonatJS Core architecture rests on three pillars: (1) Micro Routing System based on query strings with History API and automatic fallback resolution; (2) JSON-Driven Component Architecture where all layouts and content are defined as flat JavaScript objects (pages.*) without explicit HTML markup; (3) Polymorphic Render Engine that dispatches component functions (components[section]) based on the section field in data. Built-in components include: hero, features, article, titleHero, learningModule (with navigation sidebar), quizEngine (base64-protected), certificate (printable), slideViewer (PREP-structured), and live dataset editor. A Markdown-like lineRenderer supports code blocks, headings, skill bars, timeline steps, inline tables, and form validation. SVG.js integrates via svg.di(), executed automatically on every route navigation.

Sismadi Lab pipeline: sismadi.com (tinkering & proof of concept) → sismadi.sch.id (curated teaching materials) → sismadi.co.id (finished products). Nothing goes straight to production without passing through the lab.

Patent application: S00202503129 (DJKI) for a web application interface rendering system based on structured data documents with a polymorphic dispatch mechanism without framework dependencies.

Demo: https://donatjs.github.io/core/ | Repository: https://github.com/donatjs/core/
